propositions: Replay Pass-3 decision logic (validity, impact_plan, routing) deterministically over entire corpus using persisted sidecar thresholds and blocking flags, with zero LLM calls

Compute three decision variants per finding (stored, replayed-stored, live-baseline) and detect threshold/routing deltas from registry drift or candidate overlays, separately from impact-model version shifts

Use era-correct impact models per row (legacy v4 for pre-v5 findings) to prevent silent collapse of old ordinal grades, and exclude per-finding thresholds missing numeric persisted values rather than fabricating defaults
Report friction rate (live-baseline non-blocking findings that candidate would block) and relief count with per-criterion deltas, plus optional label-proxy metrics when a labels file is supplied
Complete full-corpus replay (3758 reviews, 35082 findings) in under 5 minutes with zero mismatches on plan-v4/v5 (98.8% of corpus), deferring plan-v2/v3 as out-of-scope per documented baseline
